items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: That's the second one, next to Henry.

ctx.x: eh, don't he? Yeah. He do look alike, yeah. He looks like Deacon, don't he? He looks like Arnold, eh? Oh, yeah. He looks like Arnold, eh? Right here. That's Bud. Buddy. That's Richard. Yeah. That's Abby, George, and that's Henny. Oh, and that's the other one of the Brunus boys that died. Oh, the one that worked the brewery. This here, yeah. Rudy. Rudy. Rudy Brunus. That's the second one, next to Henry. That's the one that had his boat legs in the table. Yeah, that's right. I never knew.
